description: This file defines the GeoRoutesClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Location Service Routes V2 API, such as calculating isolines, route matrices, routes, optimizing waypoints, and snapping to roads.

classes.name: GeoRoutesClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with the Amazon Location Service Routes V2 API, providing methods for geospatial routing operations.

methods.name: calculateIsolines
methods.description: Calculates isolines based on input parameters.

methods.name: calculateRouteMatrix
methods.description: Calculates a route matrix for multiple origin and destination pairs.

methods.name: calculateRoutes
methods.description: Calculates routes based on input waypoints and parameters.

methods.name: optimizeWaypoints
methods.description: Optimizes the order of waypoints for routing.

methods.name: snapToRoadsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously snaps input points to roads.
